sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No. 11321 Of 2023
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner/A1 to quash the proceedings in CC.No.309 of 2023 on the file of IV Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mahabubnagar.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mahabubnagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 420, 419, 467, 468 and 471 r/w.34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.
3. In the charge sheet, prima facie, there are certain allegations leveled against the petitioner herein.
The petitioner has to face trial and prove his innocence.
The defence taken by the petitioner cannot be considered in an application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C.

Therefore,
this Court is not inclined to quash the proceedings in CC.No.309 of 2023 on the file of IV Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mahabubnagar, against the petitioner herein.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mahabubnagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. However, having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, the attendance of the petitioner before the Court below is dispensed with subject to following directions:
i) The attendance of the petitioner is dispensed with in CC.No.309 of 2023 on the file of IV Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mahabubnagar, when represented by his counsel on record.
ii) The attendance of the petitioner is dispensed subject to filing an affidavit by the petitioner stating that in his absence the proceedings conducted by his counsel will not be disputed by him in any manner and shall not dispute his identity also.
iii) However, the petitioner shall appear before the learned Magistrate as and when his presence is required.
In the event of the petitioner's failure to appear when the Court directs, this order dispensing his attendance shall stand cancelled.
5. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed off.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.

_________________ K.SURENDER, J Date: 17.11.2023 tk Mohd.Afzal vs The State Of Telangana on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99679128/
